tips:
## Transportation in Israel

Israel has a growing public transportation network:

| Hebrew | Transliteration | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| רכבת | rakevet | train |
| אוטובוס | otobus | bus |
| מונית | monit | taxi |
| טיסה | tisah | flight |
| אופניים | ofanayim | bicycle |
| תחנה | takhanah | station/stop |

### Key Verbs for Transportation
- **נוסע/נוסעת** (nose'a/nosa'at) — travels, rides (general)
- **רוכב/רוכבת** (rokhev/rokhevet) — rides (on something: bicycle, horse)
- **נוהג/נוהגת** (noheg/noheget) — drives
- **טס/טסה** (tas/tasah) — flies

### Useful Phrases
- **נמל תעופה** (nemal te'ufah) — airport (literally: port of aviation)
- **רישיון נהיגה** (rishyon nehigah) — driver's license
- **תחנה מרכזית** (takhanah merkazit) — central station

Note: In Israel, public buses don't run on **שבת** (Shabbat), from Friday afternoon until Saturday evening.
